name: Slum Street, Square
desc1: This filthy, unused sqaure is in a state of extreme disrepair. The
desc2: tiled street is broken in many places, and in others bubbles upwards
desc3: or sinks into a bowl as the ground underneath shifts and churns.
desc4: Blackened stone chunks, smashed and displaced, are what is left of a
desc5: once-beautiful fountain that once graced the centre of the square. The
desc6: buildings lining the edge of this forgotten meeting-place stand like
desc7: disapproving sentinels, seeming to watch your every move.
